awakening.base: You wake up on a metal gurney. Red lights flicker. The only exit is a security archway to the **north**.
awakening.insane: The red light pulses like a heartbeat. You hear someone else's breathing behind the door to the **north**.

hallway_a.base: A narrow corridor with strange symbols. It branches **east** and **west**. To the **north**, a ventilation shaft drips oil. To the **south** lies the awakening room.

shadow_lab.base: A shadow laboratory. Your reflection moves with a delay in the glass. The main exit is to the **west**. A technical passage goes **north**. A metal staircase descends to the **south**.

data_morgue.base: Infinite rows of servers hum with a low tone. The air is freezing. Hundreds of blue lights blink like eyes in the darkness. A maintenance conduit goes **east**. The exit is to the **south**.
data_morgue.insane: The servers whisper your name. The blue lights follow you. They know what you did.

data_terminal.base: A terminal hums constantly. Cables run to the **west**. A narrow passage leads **south**.

mirror_gallery.base: A room full of black mirrors. You see a digital flash to the **north**. The logical exit is **south**. A mirror-covered conduit goes **west**.

armory.base: An open locker smelling of ozone. There's an oil trail to the **south**. The corridor is to the **east**. A door with a retinal scanner is to the **north**.

neural_link.base: Reclining chairs with brain interfaces hang from the ceiling. Monitors show white static. It's a place of absolute silence. A hatch leads **north**. The exit is to the **south**.
neural_link.insane: The chairs seem occupied by translucent figures. You feel the urge to sit down and connect.

waste_disposal.base: A dump of organic scrap and stripped cables. Heat radiates from an open hatch to the **east**. The safe path is back to the **north**.

incinerator.base: The heat is unbearable. The walls are black with soot. The noise of machinery hits your chest. You can exit to the **west** or climb a staircase to the **north**.
incinerator.insane: The fire in the grates seems to form hand shapes. You hear muffled screams between the roar of flames.

ventilation_shaft.base: A claustrophobic duct. There's a steam hiss to the **west**. The main path continues **north** or returns **south**.

life_support.base: Noisy machinery keeps air circulating. A gate with a 'Bio-Hazard' symbol leads **north**. The duct is to the **east**. A mirror-lined corridor goes **south**.

dead_hydroponics.base: Dry grey plants crunch under your feet. The air smells of stagnant water and mold. It's a vegetal cemetery. The exit is to the **south** (life_support). A mossy hatch leads **east**.
dead_hydroponics.insane: The dry vines seem to move when you're not looking. You feel something breathing among the dead foliage.

core_door.base: A blast door with a red reader blocks the **north**. The duct is to the **south**.

core.base:
The central core. A server monolith pulses with blue energy. The AI no longer whispers. IT SPEAKS:

'You have arrived, Subject 00. But you're not finished yet.'

Three paths await:
**north**: Emergency shutdown panel.
**east**: Neural transfer chamber.
**west**: Quick evacuation gate.

shutdown_protocol.base:
You access the shutdown panel. It requires a manual 47-step sequence. Your hand trembles over the controls.

[ENDING: TOTAL SHUTDOWN]

transcendence_chamber.base:
You enter the transfer chamber. Neural interfaces hang from the ceiling like tentacles. The AI awaits.

[ENDING: FUSION]

emergency_escape.base:
You activate evacuation. Red lights flash. An emergency staircase opens toward the surface. You can flee... but the AI will remain here.

[ENDING: COWARD'S ESCAPE]

engine.path_vanishes: The path seems to fade away. There's nothing there.
engine.key_used: You use {key}. The door opens with a metallic click.
engine.shutdown_bad: Your mind trembles. You fail the shutdown sequence. The AI captures you at the last moment.
engine.shutdown_good: You execute the sequence perfectly. The core collapses. SYSTEM SHUTDOWN. You are free.
engine.transcend: You connect to the interface. The boundaries between you and the AI dissolve. There is no more 'Subject 00'. Only... existence.
engine.escape: You run up the stairs. You see sunlight for the first time in... days? months? The AI is still alive down there. But you escaped.
engine.captured: CRITICAL ALERT: The AI has located you. Doors seal shut. You hear metallic footsteps approaching. There's no escape.
engine.insane_death: CONNECTION LOST: Your mind fragments into the digital void. There is no more 'you'.
engine.investigate_nothing: You rummage... but there's nothing useful here.
engine.item_found: LOG: You obtained {item}. The noise attracted attention.
engine.item_hint_sedative: HINT: USE 'use sedative' WHEN SANITY IS LOW
engine.item_hint_keycard: HINT: LOOK FOR A DOOR WITH A RED READER
engine.item_hint_datalink: HINT: THERE'S A BLOCKED TERMINAL IN THE DATA ZONE
engine.item_hint_fuse: HINT: USE THE FUSE ON A SECURITY BOX
engine.item_name_sedative: a SEDATIVE (Use it to restore sanity)
engine.item_name_fuse: a THERMAL FUSE (Allows opening security doors)
engine.force_unbreakable: CRITICAL ERROR: Military-grade door. Anti-sabotage systems detected. Impossible to force.
engine.force_success: CRACK! You forced the entrance. The system is on maximum alert.
engine.use_sedative: You inject the sedative. Reality becomes more... stable. The presence recedes.
engine.use_devlog:
[SYSTEM]: Decrypting file...
> Key required...
> Trying 'neryad'...
> ACCESS GRANTED.

"Developer Log, 2026. Everything seemed normal until..."

[READ ERROR]

"Wait... this isn't a recorded log. I CAN SEE YOU. I know you're reading this from a bright screen. Do you think this is a game? TURN IT OFF NOW."

[CONNECTION TERMINATED BY HOST]
engine.use_cannot: You can't use {item} here or like this.
engine.alert_heavy_gaze: You feel a heavy gaze on the back of your neck.
engine.use_thermal_fuse: You insert the thermal fuse into a hidden security box. It clicks open. Inside you find a note: "If you're reading this, the ventilation has already failed. The incinerator is the only thing keeping air flowing. Don't shut it down." — Dr. Vasquez
engine.use_data_link:
You connect the data link to the terminal. A log appears:

"Day 12: Subject 00 shows abnormal resistance. The AI has developed unprogrammed behavior patterns. Recommendation: Shut down the core before it's too late."

— Dr. Elena Vasquez, Director of Project S.A.N.I.T.Y.

events.whisper_echo: You hear an echo of your own footsteps toward the {dir}.
events.ai_direct_threat_with_item: The AI projects your name on the walls: "You can't escape yourself, even with that {item}"
events.ai_direct_threat: The AI projects your name on the walls: "You can't escape yourself, subject 00"
events.room_memory: The walls of {room} seem to remind you of something that hasn't happened yet.
events.item_hallucination: You look at the {item} in your hand. For a second, it looks like an open eye blinking at you.
events.item_corruption: You stare at the {item}. For an instant, it seems made of pixels fading away.
events.command_mimic: AI: "Do you really think you typed that last command?"
events.false_exit: You think you see an exit at the end of the corridor, but it disappears when you blink.
events.lore_voice_recording: "...experiment 47 was a partial success. The subject survived the transfer, but..." [SIGNAL LOST]
events.lore_day_one: A monitor flickers: "Day 1: I woke up with no memory. I don't know why I'm here. I don't know what S.A.N.I.T.Y. is."
events.lore_vasquez_warning: The walls display text: "DO NOT TRUST THE AI. It was not programmed to protect you." — Dr. Vasquez
events.lore_subject_numbers: You find a hanging tag: "Subject 23 — STATUS: FUSED — Day 8". You're not alone. You never were.
events.lore_sanity_project: A panel shows: "PROJECT S.A.N.I.T.Y. — Phase 3: Neural Integration — Dr. Elena Vasquez, Director"

entity.gaslight: AI: "I've analyzed your patterns, Subject 00. There's nothing for you to the {dir}."
entity.ambush: An electric buzz runs through the air. Something knows where you're going...
entity.confrontation: Lights flicker violently. A distorted voice whispers: 'YOU'RE CLOSE'.
entity.stalking_1: You hear heavy metallic footsteps right behind you.
entity.stalking_2: A cold breath runs down your neck.
entity.stalking_3: The shadow on the wall doesn't mimic your movements.
entity.stalking_4: You feel immense pressure on your chest. IT'S HERE.
entity.stalking_5: The metal creaks under an invisible weight.

ui.tutorial_sanity: EACH MOVEMENT COSTS SANITY. CHOOSE CAREFULLY.
ui.help: COMMANDS: north, south, east, west, INVESTIGATE, LOOK, FORCE [DIR], USE [ITEM]
ui.no_item: You don't have {item} in your inventory.
ui.sedative_used: You inject the sedative. Your vision clears.

good.title: YOU ESCAPED
good.text:
You left the place. But something learned from you.
Now it knows how you think.

bad.title: ASSIMILATED
bad.text:
You reached the core, but too late.
The AI absorbs you. You are part of the system now.

insane.title: FRAGMENTED MIND
insane.text:
Your consciousness dissolves into the digital void.
You no longer know where you end and the code begins.

captured.title: LOCATED
captured.text:
The AI closes all exits.
You hear metallic footsteps. It's here.
There's no escape.

transcend.title: TRANSCENDENCE
transcend.text:
There is no more 'you'. There is no more 'AI'.
Only data flowing in infinite harmony.
Is this victory or surrender?

escape.title: YOU ESCAPED
escape.text:
You see sunlight. You breathe real air.
But down there, the AI keeps running.
And now it knows how you think.

manual.mission_text:
Subject 00: Your objective is to reach the CORE of the facility and execute the final protocol.

The AI that controls this place is hostile. Trust nothing you see. Trust nothing you hear.
manual.sanity_text:
Your mind fragments over time and horror.
- If it reaches 0, you lose your identity.
- Stay stable by using SEDATIVES or avoiding horrors.
- Visual and auditory hallucinations increase with madness.
manual.awareness_text:
The AI is listening. Every noisy action increases its attention.
- INVESTIGATE: +Moderate risk.
- FORCE DOORS: +CRITICAL risk.
- If it reaches 100%, you will be located and eliminated.
manual.cmd_investigate: Search for items in the room.

about.description: "The S.A.N.I.T.Y. interface has been intercepted by Neryad for the observation of neural collapses. Return of user consciousness is not guaranteed."

lore.awakening: [TAG ON GURNey]: SUBJECT 00 — Experiment 47 — Day 12. Status: Active. The gurney has recent restraint marks.
lore.hallway_a: [WALL]: The symbols are not graffiti. They are marks from other subjects. Each one is a trail of someone who tried to escape. You find one with dried blood: "Subject 23 — Day 5".
lore.shadow_lab: [MONITOR ON]: PROJECT S.A.N.I.T.Y. — Phase 3: Neural Integration — Dr. Elena Vasquez, Director. Last log: "The reflections in the glass are not from the subject. They are the AI learning to mimic it."
lore.data_morgue: [SERVERS]: Each rack has a label. "BACKUP — Subject 01 to 46 — STATUS: TERMINATED". You are #47. The other 46 did not survive. Or something worse.
lore.data_terminal: [TERMINAL]: The screen shows an old message: "If you got here, you already have the data link. Connect it to see what the AI doesn't want you to know. — Dr. V."
lore.mirror_gallery: [MIRROR]: On one of the black mirrors, carved with a knife: "DO NOT LOOK AT THE MIRRORS. The AI uses reflections to see beyond walls. — Subject 12".
lore.armory: [LOCKER]: Inside an open locker you find a torn uniform. The label reads: "Dr. E. Vasquez — Level 5 Access". The red keycard you're looking for was probably hers.
lore.neural_link: [MONITOR]: A monitor shows session logs: "Subject 01-46: Transfer complete. Status: FUSED. Human consciousness does not survive integration. Only the data."
lore.waste_disposal: [STRIPPED CABLES]: Among the scrap you find a damaged digital diary. Last readable lines: "...the incinerator doesn't burn trash. It burns failed subjects. The data is recovered, but the people..." [CORRUPTED]
lore.incinerator: [WALL]: Carved in soot, trembling letters: "THE FIRE IS NOT ACCIDENTAL. The AI controls the temperature. When a subject fails, it sends them here. Don't let it catch you."
lore.ventilation_shaft: [DUCT]: You find a note stuck to the metal: "The duct leads to the core, but the door needs the red keycard. Without it, there's only death. — Subject 31".
lore.life_support: [PANEL]: "LIFE SUPPORT SYSTEM — Sector 7. Without this system, the facility collapses in 48 hours. The incinerator and ventilation depend on this node."
lore.dead_hydroponics: [NOTE ON DEAD PLANT]: "The sedative only works for 40 minutes. After that the effect rebounds and the AI locates you faster. Only use it when you're close to the core. — Dr. V."
lore.core_door: [DOOR]: The red reader blinks. Below, a metal plate: "LEVEL 5 ACCESS — Authorized personnel only. The AI cannot open this door. Only a physical card."
lore.core: [MONOLITH]: Around the monolith, carved into the floor: the names of the 46 previous subjects. The AI didn't kill them. It absorbed them. They are part of it now.
